বর্ণ খুঁজে বের করি। গোল দাগ দিই।

image_slots.scene_description: ঋতু-এর ছবি: ছয় ঋতুর প্রতীক ফুল/প্রকৃতি — object/scenery only, ফুলে ভরা মাঠ ও গাছ, কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই (NCTB p18 এর পাখি বাদ — 'পাখি গায়' লাইন পরিবর্তিত)।
image_slots.compliance_note: scenery-only slot; flowering field/tree conveying the six seasons; NO birds (the NCTB 'পাখি গায়' line was changed → bird removed from art too); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a flowering field with a leafy tree and blooming marigolds and small blossoms under a soft sky, no animals, no people. Centred, plain white background, bold clean outlines, soft flat colour. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: পাঠ-অনুশীলন দৃশ্য (NCTB p19 reframe): দুই ছাত্র (উমর, আনাস) মেঝেতে বসে খাতায় বর্ণ লিখছে, মাঝে একটি বিড়াল, পাশে রঙপেন্সিলের বাক্স। সবাই ছেলে, পূর্ণ পোশাক (কুর্তা-পায়জামা/ফুলহাতা+টুপি)। কোনো মেয়ে/প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: NCTB p19 shows a mixed boy+girl pair in short-sleeve shirts+shorts with a cat (C-01 free-mixing + C-02 dress). REFRAMED same-gender: two boys উমর+আনাস from cast refs (C-01/D-013), modest full-length dress + caps (C-02), redrawn from reference sheets (C-05/C-06). Cat retained (animal a scene detail). Any writing shown in the open books is illegible scribble-lines, NOT real letters (script guard — no AI-baked Bengali text). Stripe lands on plain floor, clear of faces/hands and the cat. High-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A warm children's-textbook illustration of two young Muslim schoolboys sitting on the floor, each with an open exercise book, practising writing, with a small friendly cat sitting between them and a box of colour pencils beside them. Both boys wear neat modest full-length clothing with small caps. The marks in the open books are just soft illegible squiggles, with no real letters or text anywhere. Plain white background, soft watercolour style, clean bold outlines. No girls, no adults. High contrast and clean linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: বর্ণ-লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট — ঋ, স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট থেকে অ্যাসেম্বলিতে বসবে।
image_slots.compliance_note: letter-tracing grid for ঋ with stroke-order arrows; vector asset, never AI-generated.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ১৩ বর্ণ-শিখি: ঋ (🔒 স্থির, single vowel). Title + letter + পড়ি/লিখি retained. TEXT CHANGE (user): NCTB rhyme 'ঋতু আসে ঋতু যায় / ফুল ফোটে পাখি গায় / বাংলাদেশে ছয়টি ঋতু' → line 2 changed 'ফুল ফোটে পাখি গায়' to 'ফুল ফোটে মন ভোলায়' (removes the singing-bird / পাখি গায়); lines 1 & 3 kept verbatim. Rhyme preserved (‑ায়, যায়/ভোলায়), ছড়া meter intact, clean meaning ('flowers bloom, delight the heart'). This makes b04 edited=true but oral=true (শুনি-ও-বলি rhyme) → letter-audit EXEMPT; still curated. c_codes add C-08 for the line word-swap. Because 'পাখি গায়' removed, the illustration also drops the bird → scenery-only flowering field (no living being). Taught inventory at পাঠ ১৩ = অ,আ,ই,ঈ,উ,ঊ,ঋ only (no consonants/কার): all words oral named examples; only decodable content = the letter ঋ (b08/b10), NCTB-original → exempt. WORD PROVENANCE: map has ONLY ঋতু (single ঋ-initial book word). Confirmed vs Bangla Academy আধুনিক অভিধান (baabo.jothartho.com/list/ঋ): ঋ is the most word-poor vowel — the ONLY clean concrete child-appropriate word is ঋতু. Entire rest of ঋ-inventory is Hindu-religious (ঋষি/ঋক্/ঋগ্বেদ family — C-09 creed, REFUSED), debt-concept (ঋণ family), or abstract/archaic (ঋজু/ঋদ্ধ/ঋত/ঋভু/ঋষভ). ⚠ PER PRINCIPAL (chat): keep ঋতু + ঋণ + ঋজু. FLAGS for reviewer: ঋণ = 'debt/loan', abstract + off-register for age 5-6; ঋজু = 'straight/upright', abstract + literary (not in a first-grader's speech). Both retained on instruction, WORD-ONLY (no image, not picture-able), reviewer to confirm suitability. NOT used: ঋষি/ঋক্ষ etc (C-09). Images: ঋতু scenery-only flowering field (bird removed per line change); tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. No cast figures → refs empty. Ready to merge in order after পাঠ ১২. [UPDATE p19] Extended পাঠ ১৩ to pages [18,19] — the NCTB বর্ণ-খুঁজি/সাজিয়ে-লিখি review spread (page 19) practises the vowels অ–ঋ (exercise row ই উ অ ঈ আ উ ঋ, all taught by পাঠ ১৩) and belongs with this পাঠ (not a separately-numbered পাঠ in the 54-list; interstitial practice attached to the vowel block; পাঠ ১৪ starts p20). Added b11–b14 (instruction + circle-row + সাজিয়ে-লিখি label + write-boxes; all source=nctb edited=false → audit-exempt; content is in-inventory anyway). Added two-boys cast image (L013-img-03): NCTB p19 boy+girl+cat in short-sleeves/shorts (C-01 free-mixing + C-02 dress) REFRAMED same-gender → উমর+আনাস from cast refs, modest full dress+caps (C-01/C-02/C-05/C-06), cat retained; open-book writing = illegible squiggles only (script guard). c_codes add C-01.
